note: The lead left the fee null on 2026-10-31: the card's N$200 (reg. 118) is paid with the N$160 application fee, and no text read says what a first licence costs in all. Read 2026-10-31. The Road Traffic and Transport Regulations, 2001 (Government Notice 53 of 2001, under s. 91 of the Road Traffic and Transport Act 22 of 1999), in the Legal Assistance Centre's annotated text, which incorporates every amending notice to GN 298 of 2021 (GG 7716) and the commencement of 30 September 2022 (read from its Word file, saved as text): reg. 110(6)(b), the minimum age for a code B driving licence is 18 (as amended by GN 163/2002; a learner's licence for code 2 is from 17); reg. 111(2), a driving licence issued under s. 37 of the Act is valid five years; reg. 116, applications are made to a driving testing centre; reg. 118, an applicant who passes the practical test pays the Schedule 1 fee and the driving examiner authorises the issue. Schedule 1 as substituted by GN 102 of 2020 (Government Gazette 7172 of 3 April 2020, read in the gazette itself, as the LAC hosts it): item 23, issue of a driving licence card of any code, N$200.00 (regulation 118), the fee written; item 20, application for a driving licence code A1, A, B, BE, N$160.00, is paid besides it and isn't in the fee. No amending notice after GN 298 of 2021 was looked for; namiblii.org, which holds the regulations, answers this egress with a Cloudflare challenge.
